200.html:
data

[object]

A list of RUM-based metric objects.

attributes

object

The object describing a Datadog RUM-based metric.

compute

object

The compute rule of the RUM-based metric.

aggregation_type

enum

The type of aggregation to use. count counts the matching events. distribution aggregates the values found at path. Allowed enum values: count,distribution

include_percentiles

boolean

Toggle to include or exclude percentile aggregations (p50, p75, p90, p95, p99) for distribution metrics. Required when aggregation_type is distribution, and must be omitted otherwise.

path

string

The path of the numeric RUM event attribute the metric aggregates on. Only present when aggregation_type is distribution.

event_type

enum

The type of RUM events the metric is generated from. It is set at creation and cannot be changed. Allowed enum values: session,view,action,error,resource,long_task,vital

filter

object

The RUM-based metric filter. RUM events matching this filter are aggregated in this metric. Omitted if the metric only filters on the event type.

query

string

The search query, following the RUM search syntax. It does not include the event type filter.

group_by

[object]

The rules the metric is grouped by. Omitted if the metric is not grouped.

path

string

The path of the RUM event attribute the metric is grouped by.

tag_name

string

Name of the tag created on the metric. By default, path is used as the tag name.

uniqueness

object

The rule to count updatable events. Only present if event_type is session or view, and absent on older metrics created before this setting existed.

when

enum

When to count updatable events. match when the event is first seen, or end when the event is complete. Sessions and views are updated over time, each one is counted once. Allowed enum values: match,end

id

string

The name of the RUM-based metric. On creation, it must be 1 to 200 characters long, contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and periods, start with a letter, and not start with rum.measure or rum.investigate. It cannot be changed after creation.

type

enum

The type of the resource. The value must be rum_metrics. Allowed enum values: rum_metrics

default: rum_metrics

request.html:
data [required]

object

The new RUM-based metric properties.

attributes [required]

object

The object describing the Datadog RUM-based metric to create.

compute [required]

object

The compute rule to compute the RUM-based metric. It is set at creation and only include_percentiles can be updated afterwards.

aggregation_type [required]

enum

The type of aggregation to use. count counts the matching events. distribution aggregates the values found at path. Allowed enum values: count,distribution

include_percentiles

boolean

Toggle to include or exclude percentile aggregations (p50, p75, p90, p95, p99) for distribution metrics. Required when aggregation_type is distribution, and must be omitted otherwise.

path

string

The path of the numeric RUM event attribute the metric aggregates on. Only valid when aggregation_type is distribution.

event_type [required]

enum

The type of RUM events the metric is generated from. It is set at creation and cannot be changed. Allowed enum values: session,view,action,error,resource,long_task,vital

filter

object

The RUM-based metric filter. Events matching this filter will be aggregated in this metric. The event_type filter is added automatically.

query [required]

string

The search query, following the RUM search syntax. Do not include a @type filter, it is derived from event_type. It must not contain invisible or control characters such as non-breaking or zero-width spaces. When updating a metric, an empty query leaves the filter unchanged.

default: *

group_by

[object]

The rules to group the metric by. Each rule creates a tag on the generated metric. If omitted, the metric is not grouped.

path [required]

string

The path of the RUM event attribute to group the metric by.

tag_name

string

Name of the tag that gets created on the metric. By default, path is used as the tag name. It must be at most 200 characters long, start with a letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, colons, periods, and slashes.

uniqueness

object

The rule to count updatable events. Required when event_type is session or view, and must be omitted for other event types. It cannot be changed after creation.

when [required]

enum

When to count updatable events. match when the event is first seen, or end when the event is complete. Sessions and views are updated over time, each one is counted once. Allowed enum values: match,end

id [required]

string

The name of the RUM-based metric. On creation, it must be 1 to 200 characters long, contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and periods, start with a letter, and not start with rum.measure or rum.investigate. It cannot be changed after creation.

type [required]

enum

The type of the resource. The value must be rum_metrics. Allowed enum values: rum_metrics

default: rum_metrics

request.html:
data [required]

object

The RUM-based metric properties to update. id is required by the API and must match the metric_id path parameter.

attributes [required]

object

The RUM-based metric properties that will be updated. Omitted properties keep their current value.

compute

object

The compute rule properties that can be updated. Only valid for metrics whose aggregation_type is distribution.

include_percentiles

boolean

Toggle to include or exclude percentile aggregations (p50, p75, p90, p95, p99) for distribution metrics. Required when aggregation_type is distribution, and must be omitted otherwise.

filter

object

The RUM-based metric filter. Events matching this filter will be aggregated in this metric. The event_type filter is added automatically.

query [required]

string

The search query, following the RUM search syntax. Do not include a @type filter, it is derived from event_type. It must not contain invisible or control characters such as non-breaking or zero-width spaces. When updating a metric, an empty query leaves the filter unchanged.

default: *

group_by

[object]

The rules to group the metric by. When provided, replaces all the existing group by rules.

path [required]

string

The path of the RUM event attribute to group the metric by.

tag_name

string

Name of the tag that gets created on the metric. By default, path is used as the tag name. It must be at most 200 characters long, start with a letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, colons, periods, and slashes.

id

string

The name of the RUM-based metric. On creation, it must be 1 to 200 characters long, contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and periods, start with a letter, and not start with rum.measure or rum.investigate. It cannot be changed after creation.

type [required]

enum

The type of the resource. The value must be rum_metrics. Allowed enum values: rum_metrics

default: rum_metrics
